question: Which device is used to protect against electric shocks and fires caused by earth leakage currents?
solution:
The correct answer is __Earth Leakage Circuit Breaker**(ELCB)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Earth Leakage Circuit Breaker__ is abbreviated as ELCB.
 
• ELCB is a safety device used in electrical installations.
 
• It detects earth leakage currents and disconnects the circuit to prevent electric shocks.
 
• ELCB is primarily used to protect humans and equipment from electric faults.
 
• It operates by monitoring leakage currents to the ground and automatically trips the circuit if a fault is detected.
 
• ELCBs are an essential part of ensuring electrical safety in homes and industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Miniature Circuit Breaker (MCB):**
 
 
• It is an electromechanical device designed to protect an electric circuit from overcurrent or short circuits.
 
• MCBs are commonly used in homes and buildings for low-power applications.
 
 
 
• **Molded Case Circuit Breaker (MCCB):**
 
 
• MCCB is used for overload and short circuit protection in high-power applications.
 
• MCCBs are typically used in industrial settings and for higher current ratings.
 
 
 
• **Earth Circuit Breaker (ECB):**
 
 
• The term ECB is sometimes used interchangeably with ELCB but is not a commonly recognized standard term in electrical engineering.
